# EnterpriseGlue v0.40.2 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.40.1`.

## Highlights

- **frontend:** Keeps an organization switch stable when another workspace is open in the same browser.

## User and administrator impact

- An open tab affected by a change to the shared session offers an organization choice before changing the session again.

## Database migrations

- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- Browser tabs recheck the server session and its permission snapshot after a change to shared browser storage.

## Documentation

- The release notes describe how a previously open workspace tab responds to an organization change.

## Published packages

| Package | Previous | New | Impact |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `@enterpriseglue/frontend-host` | `0.21.1` | `0.21.2` | patch |

## Rollback

- Redeploy the previous compatible application images.

## Validation evidence

- A Chromium regression opens two workspace tabs and verifies that only the explicitly selected tab exchanges the organization session.
